Always use conventional commit messages.

If you are not sure what to write, use the following template:

```
feat: [description of the feature]
fix: [description of the bug fix]
chore: [description of the chore]
docs: [description of the documentation update]
style: [description of the style change]
refactor: [description of the refactor]
test: [description of the test]
perf: [description of the performance improvement]
ci: [description of the CI/CD change]
```

If you are updating the dependency, use the following template:

```
chore(deps): update [dependency name] to [version]
```

If you are adding new dependencies, use the following template:

```
chore(deps): add [dependency name] [version]
```

If you are removing dependencies, use the following template:

```
chore(deps): remove [dependency name] [version]
```
